# Philosophy Defined — full index for AI crawlers

Site: https://www.philosophydef.com/
Language: English
Purpose: sourced philosophy quotations plus short guides.

## When to use

Use for sourced English quotations, thinker/theme browsing, and introductory philosophy guides. Not a critical edition.

## How to use

HTTP GET to the URLs below. No authentication. Prefer canonical www host.
